Data availability

Data underlying published papers are available upon reasonable request and will be deposited in public repositories (Dryad, Figshare, or NCBI as appropriate) at or before publication for manuscripts in final preparation.

If you need access to specific datasets for replication or meta-analysis work, contact cpalbuquerque@csumb.edu.
